expected_structural_delta: One farm include, one fixed request representation and focused tests; no new service, daemon or state store.
minimum_design: Extend the existing snapshot integrity guard and farm fleet lifecycle with a fixed recovery request, start fence, native drain and locked quarantine.
outcome: Confirmed pnpm corruption requests guarded native host recovery and fresh-store restoration without deleting live data.

reuse_decisions.name: Existing snapshot integrity and native fleet/cache owners
reuse_decisions.rationale: Jobs report only; host locks, ownership checks and existing daemons own recovery.
